18.t: Working with data: who visits the flowers?
q: Which visitor came to the sunflower most often?
Calculate the total visits to each flower.
Suggest why birds visited only the hibiscus.
Its long tube holds nectar deep inside: birds with long beaks can reach it, and its large red petals attract them.
A student concludes sunflowers are pollinated better. Evaluate this conclusion.
More visits do not prove more pollination: we do not know if pollen was carried between flowers. The count was one 30-minute period on one day; repeat at different times.
